chunks: "Whoever has intercourse with a woman before she reaches nine years of age, and she suffers a defect or injury, then he is liable."

key_terms.بِامْرَأَةٍ: with a woman or female spouse
key_terms.تَبْلُغَ: reaches or attains the specified age
key_terms.دَخَلَ: had intercourse or consummated the marriage
key_terms.ضَامِنٌ: legally liable or responsible for compensation
key_terms.عَيْبٌ: a defect, injury, or harm suffered

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if intercourse takes place before a girl reaches nine years of age and she is harmed?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning intercourse with a girl before she reaches nine years of age. If harm or injury results from that act, the man bears legal liability for it.
